usage: 牛仔布 (denim) is a noun referring to a sturdy cotton twill fabric commonly used for making jeans.
You can use 牛仔布 to describe clothing material, especially casual pants and jackets.
When talking about fabrics, 牛仔布 usually refers specifically to the textile material, not just the finished clothing.
牛仔布 can be combined with other words to describe products, e.g., 牛仔布褲 (denim pants).
This noun is uncountable, so it usually does not have a plural form in Cantonese.
